name: Lakeway Village Square
summary: Lakeway Village Square is a neighborhood shopping center serving the affluent lakeside community of Lakeway, Texas, along Lake Travis. The center features 21 suites housing local businesses and service providers that cater to the daily needs of residents in this upscale Hill Country community.
demographics: Lakeway Village Square serves the affluent Lakeway community in the Texas Hill Country, attracting upper-middle-class families and retirees with household incomes significantly above the national average. The trade area draws from the surrounding lakeside residential communities along Lake Travis, with visitors typically aged 35-65 who value convenience and quality over discount shopping. The center caters to an educated, professional demographic seeking everyday services and specialty retail in a convenient neighborhood setting, with shopping patterns focused on regular visits for services, dining, and local needs rather than destination shopping trips.
description: Lakeway Village Square is a neighborhood shopping center serving the scenic lakeside community of Lakeway, Texas, located along the shores of Lake Travis in the Texas Hill Country. This convenient retail destination provides essential services and shopping options to the affluent residential communities that surround it, offering a mix of local businesses and service providers. The center features suites numbered 1 through 21, housing a variety of tenants that cater to the daily needs of Lakeway residents and visitors to the area. With its accessible location on Lakeway Drive and operating hours from 7:00 AM to 10:00 PM, the center serves as a community hub for this upscale lakeside town. The shopping center maintains a strong reputation with a 4.4-star rating from 78 reviews, reflecting its role as a valued neighborhood retail destination in one of the Austin area's most desirable communities.
